content.text: I escalated T-2008 rather than resolving it. The failed Job's logs show it already successfully charged ~4,812 of 9,950 invoices (~€2.3M) before aborting on a gateway 429, and the tool explicitly logs that it has no resume checkpoint and the payment client sends no idempotency keys. Blindly deleting and recreating the Job as requested would re-charge customers who were already billed, so a billing engineer needs to reconcile against the gateway and run a scoped backfill for only the remaining invoices.
